recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片見許多體積很小、深染且無中央淡染區的小球形紅血球（microspherocytes），並有少數鋸齒狀紅血球；這些微小球形細胞在阻抗法血球計數時可能被誤算為血小板，造成血小板數假性偏高。
features: Numerous microspherocytes: small, dense, round red cells without central pallor
Background normocytic red cells with central pallor
Few small purple particles consistent with platelets or debris
No definite schistocytes or nucleated red cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous microspherocytes, which are small, densely staining round red cells lacking central pallor, admixed with normocytic red cells and occasional crenated cells. Definite schistocytes are not identified in this field. In the setting of a scorpion sting with DIC, the microspherocytes are compatible with venom-induced red cell membrane injury and hemolysis. Because microspherocytes may be counted as platelets by impedance analyzers, the platelet count should be verified by smear review or an optical or immunologic method.

ddx.vs: HS spherocytes are less uniformly minute, with a chronic history, positive family history and reduced EMA binding.
AIHA spherocytes are accompanied by a positive direct antiglobulin test and often polychromasia.
These also cause microspherocytes but are distinguished by history (burn injury, clostridial infection) rather than morphology.
MAHA/DIC classically shows schistocytes (helmet cells, fragments), which are not prominent in this field.
